title: Pauli Contextuality Lab: Unified Lean 4.35.0 Formalization of Spectral Bounds, Disjoint Mermin Configurations, and Sequential Contextuality Evidence
peer_review_status: Consolidated research preprint suite (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 & cross-platform CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

C3Certificate/C3Spectra, 16 explicit, SLSA #73146760] and lean-verify-phase7 [VerifyPhaseSeven.lean, 7-qubit SaturatedPhaseSeven degree 729,344, 5 explicit, SLSA #73122769]; 0 Batteries linter errors across 10 modules; 18 cross-track targets verified across 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid in Ubuntu CI run 46007131056, SLSA #73132718; Release v3.2.0 run 46016387888 SLSA #73148255)

core_result: Consolidates the four archived Pauli/Mermin contextuality repositories into one unified Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0 monorepo meeting Build Standard v1.2.0 (100.0%, 68/68 checks, Core 30/30) and Playbook v1.3, closing all six remaining formal-code architectural errata in Lean 4.35.0. Ships a pinned Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 workspace (64 .lean files; all 9 standalone Track 1 finite-certificate modules now compiled and axiom-audited live in parallel CI via VerifyStandalone.lean and VerifyPhaseSeven.lean), searchable 27-node / 194-declaration Lean Blueprint with MathJax SRI, explicit Sp(2N,2) witness isomorphism verifier & hyperbolic quasi-quadric (135/1,095/75) Qontextium exports, 4 zero-overflow Tectonic PDFs (0.00pt max overfull), and 3-OS + 14-engine C11 ASan/UBSan CI (run 46007131046). Track 1 formalizes Jonah's universal and Kramers spectral floors (arbitrary supports), two-sided asymptotic 1/2 limits (including universal averaging upper bound exists_assignment_violated_le_half and Q+ assignment limit), five-way saturation equivalences, finite flat degrees 75, 480, 2016 and 729344 (live-audited in CI), infinite non-closed pure-CCZ family |Psi_{3m}> (m>=1, contextual m>=2), lower bounds d(W(7,2))>=1455 and d(Q+(9,2))>=6444 (below Jonah's earlier 1575/6975 claims), exact four-qubit C3 binary completion optima (368 vs 344), formal geometric vertex-case membership predicates IsCaseC1-IsCaseC15 (ConjectureECases.lean) + strict-law failure for one representative per case for all N>=4 (whole-case transfer via Jonah's Theorem B4 outside Lean), and 8 kernel-proved perturbed-bound refutations. Track 2 proves exact disjoint-copy degrees d_k=(7^k-5^k)/2 (squares) and (6^k-4^k)/2 (pentagrams) with genuine minimum actualMinViolations, literal 2- and 3-qubit Pauli matrices, 4- and 6-qubit bridges, kernel-decided equality with HS(L(K_{3,3})) and HS(Petersen), and arbitrary-k Support.lean instantiation (SeedSupport.lean), answering Muller & Saniga (arXiv:2609.19862v1 Sec. 6) for squares and pentagrams. Track 3 proves finite adaptive-tree sequential evidence bounds and a sharp Peres-Mermin setting-bias attack. All 3 parallel Lean CI jobs (run 46007131056) passed 100% green: 198 explicit + 2,306 exhaustive axioms, 10-module Batteries linter, 18 targets across 6 independent kernels (SLSA #73132718), VerifyStandalone (SLSA #73146760), VerifyPhaseSeven (SLSA #73122769), Release v3.2.0 (SLSA #73148255), and Software Heritage full snapshot swh:1:snp:cf9ae7bd108e9556e79d4c0c81c8de92632b91c1.
verification_boundary: All 64 .lean files in the workspace are live-compiled and axiom-audited strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] across three parallel Ubuntu CI jobs in run 46007131056: VerifyAll.lean (198 explicit #print axioms + 2,306 kernel theorem constants across 45 modules / 1,203 non-Challenge authored declarations, 0 Batteries linter errors across 10 modules, 18 cross-track Challenge/Solution targets accepted by all 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid, SLSA #73132718), VerifyStandalone.lean (8 standalone Track 1 modules including C3Certificate/C3Spectra and 4-/5-qubit saturated degrees, 16 explicit, SLSA #73146760), and VerifyPhaseSeven.lean (7-qubit SaturatedPhaseSeven degree 729,344, 5 explicit, SLSA #73122769). 52 pytest suites (+6 subtests), 2 Node tests, 7 exact verifiers, and 14 zero-warning C11 ASan/UBSan engines pass across Linux/macOS/Windows CI (run 46007131046). Remaining outside Lean: whole-case single-orbit transitivity via Jonah's Theorem B4, finite C censuses (540.3M N=9 forms, 42-orbit W(5,2) census), Track 2 general-seed Theorem 5 / heterogeneous Theorem 2 / mixed-family (12) / k>=3 literal matrix bridges, Moonlab/QGTL/QRNG simulations, and exploratory floating-point scripts. No external peer review, hardware experiment, or external DOI is claimed; DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA + 3-calendar OpenTimestamps verified in CI; SWH swh:1:snp:cf9ae7bd108e9556e79d4c0c81c8de92632b91c1.
